args: Preserve declared suite coverage through explicit project-provider CI mappings
stdout:
## User Story

As an AITM delivery operator
I want to explicitly map declared full-suite commands to validated CI coverage because Test currently reruns those suites on the host
So that native delivery can retain full-suite evidence while the host runs only affected tests

## Scope

Add optional explicit test.declaredCommandCoverage entries to the project verification provider. Each entry names one allowlisted declared command and nonempty unique requires classifications from configured Test steps. Validate the entire declaration fail-closed before execution. Covered issue commands produce derived result records requiring genuine successful configured step records and never execute locally; uncovered issue commands remain executable targeted steps. No inference from classification names. Default Node and unconfigured project behavior remain unchanged. Document honest CI receipt use and adopt explicit full-lane coverage for the repository cloud verifier. Host runs affected tests only; full suites run in authenticated exact-head hosted CI.

## Reproduction

Configure a project Test step with classification test-cloud-complete and command node scripts/maintenance/verify-ci-receipts.mjs. Call resolveVerificationProvider(...).planTest with declared npm test and npm run test:slow. Actual plan includes both as executable test-targeted steps after the cloud verifier; it has no derivedSteps. Native #1897 then executed 954 full host fast files before root interrupted execution.

## Root Cause

Project planTest passes every declared command to appendTargeted; only exact command matches against configured steps are deduplicated. Registry permits no explicit declaration that a configured verifier covers another declared command. Node provider has derived compatibility results, but project provider does not.

## Fix Direction

Implement the smallest regression-protected correction that satisfies the Acceptance Criteria while preserving unrelated behavior.

## Out of Scope

No blanket skip of declared tests, inferred universal cloud coverage, invented execution receipts, weakened allowlist, workflow bypass, edits to approved #144 Scope or private accepted artifacts, or node_modules patches. No changes to default Node lanes.

## Story Origin

- **kind**: code
- **provenance**: Observed during authorized delivery of ai-peer-review#107/#144 and ai-task-manager#1897. Native #1897 Test executed the full host fast suite after a successful exact-head cloud receipt verifier, contrary to the user TIA-only host constraint. The public provider plan reproduces the appended npm test and npm run test:slow without executing either. Evidence retained in .scratch/1897/root-project-provider-host-suite-plan.json and interrupted-test-preservation/.
- **relationships**: Blocks ai-task-manager#1897 and ai-peer-review#144/#107 native Test completion. Separate from #1897 canonical AC scope.

## Plan Metadata



## Pickup Directive — MANDATORY, DO NOT SKIP

> Follow: `.ai-task-manager/templates/pickup-directive.md`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Explicit valid coverage maps declared full-suite commands to derived results while retaining affected local checks and genuine executed cloud commands. <!-- aitm-verified vc-list="vc:1" -->
- [ ] Invalid, empty, duplicate, unknown or non-Test references fail before provider execution; failed prerequisite results cannot satisfy derived commands. <!-- aitm-verified vc-list="vc:1" -->
- [ ] Without coverage configuration, project and Node provider behavior is unchanged and uncovered commands still execute. <!-- aitm-verified vc-list="vc:1" -->

## Verification Commands

- [ ] `node --test scripts/tests/unit/task-tracker/lib/verification-provider-registry.test.mjs scripts/tests/unit/task-tracker/lib/test-verb-receipt-reuse.test.mjs` <!-- id=1 -->
- [ ] `npm test` <!-- id=2 -->
- [ ] `npm run test:slow` <!-- id=3 -->
- [ ] `npm run lint` <!-- id=4 -->
- [ ] `npm run format:check` <!-- id=5 -->
- [ ] `git log --oneline -1` <!-- id=6 -->

## Definition of Done
<!--
Each item below MUST be individually verified by running the declared
verifier. Do not bulk-check. Do not preemptively check. The visible checkbox
is the sign-off; the hidden `aitm-dod-evidence:<key>` marker is the evidence
trail. `/task check` refuses to tick a stampable Functional DoD item without
its marker; run `/task dod-stamp <key>` to produce one. The two derived keys
(`acs`, `checkboxes`) are auto-stamped by `/task close` from the body itself.
See `skill/shared/rules/functional-dod.md` for the full contract.

Lifecycle items are verified during Review. Housekeeping items are finalized
during Close; their separate headings make the owning workflow phase explicit.

Kind-aware items (#681): append a `dod:kinds` HTML-comment annotation to scope
an item to a set of issue kinds. `exclude="spike,research"` renders the item for
every kind EXCEPT those listed; `include="code"` renders it only for the listed
kinds; an item with no annotation applies to every kind (the default). The
`tests` item is excluded for the no-code kinds `spike` and `research`, which ship
findings rather than code and would otherwise carry a test-suite DoD item and a
`npm run test:all` verification command they can never satisfy. Filtering happens
at render time in `preflight-issue.mjs`; a filtered-out item is simply absent, so
no phantom evidence marker is ever required for it.

Diff-decides for `docs-only` (#865): the `tests` item deliberately does NOT
static-exclude `docs-only`. A `docs-only` issue can quietly touch code, so the
kind alone must not launder it out of the suite. Instead the `tests` item is
dropped only when the render is `--kind docs-only` AND a supplied
`--changed-paths-file` proves the `trunk...HEAD` diff is documentation-only
(default-deny: any unclassified/empty/mixed diff keeps the item). "The kind
declares, the diff decides."
-->
